lab: FAE – Mining Tip Sync & Stale Work Recovery
block_time_policy: Correctness must hold independently of 180s versus 300s target selection.
private_material_policy: Seed phrases, private keys, and reusable secret material must never enter Lab fixtures, logs, or evidence.
failure_policy: Fail closed on authority ambiguity. MTS-00/01 may not edit active miner/runtime code. A later explicit gate is required before candidate mining.js writes.
deletion_invariant: Removing lab/mining-tip-sync and its Lab-only documentation must not change active FAE mining, wallet, consensus, economics, or public-testnet behavior.

canonical_failure.failing_gate: Verify deployed browser security sources match Forge snapshot

miner_mirror_authorization_basis.purpose: byte-identical browser miner mirror plus integrity-manifest renewal only

provenance_resolution.resolution: Mirror candidate miner byte-for-byte into sovereign-forge/browser/mining.js and renew only its FAE_FORGE_MAIN.sha256 entry, following established repository protocol.

failed_canonical_run.failing_gate: Verify browser wallet, client, coordinator fallback, trust and rotation flows

canonical_fixture_update_authorization_b.purpose: Make canonical direct-fallback smoke fixture match the already-live /status height+tip_hash contract. No runtime relaxation.

mts_05_intermediate_failure.cause: canonical smoke /status fixture omitted tip_hash even though production v4 /status already exposes it
mts_05_intermediate_failure.resolution: align the exact smoke fixture with production height+tip_hash contract; retain fail-closed runtime behavior

mts_07_authority.purpose: Attempt to break the integrated MTS-04/05 behavior under rapid tips, delayed scheduling/CPU-like callback pressure, and transient network failures before authorizing any new runtime patch.
mts_07_authority.runtime_patch_gate: Only if deterministic MTS-07 evidence exposes a reproducible defect.

mts_08_authority.required_property: Returning from background/suspension must trigger immediate authoritative revalidation of active direct PoW instead of waiting for a throttled polling timer.
mts_08_authority.safety_property: Even if lifecycle revalidation is delayed, pre-submit freshness must still prevent stale submission.
mts_08_authority.runtime_patch_gate: Only a deterministic lifecycle reproduction may authorize a miner patch.

passed: stale solution after suspension remains blocked by pre-submit freshness
unchanged authoritative tip does not false-cancel on synthetic resume events
failed: visibilitychange to visible did not immediately revalidate/cancel stale direct work
pageshow did not immediately revalidate/cancel stale direct work

mts_08_patch_authorization.scope: mining.js + byte-identical Sovereign Forge mirror + exact protected hash renewal
required_behavior: visibilitychange to visible triggers immediate authoritative revalidation of active direct work
pageshow triggers immediate authoritative revalidation of active direct work
unknown/unavailable lifecycle freshness fails closed without block submission
lifecycle hook does not affect coordinator/PPLNS work when no direct observer is active

mts_09_authority_preview.principle: Each context must converge from authoritative network state independently; same-device hints may accelerate but cannot be required.

completed_runtime_delta.rule: These paths may appear in the closing MTS-10 PR delta only while root and Forge miner bytes plus the integrity manifest remain bound to this exact SHA-256. This does not authorize MTS-11 runtime writes.

required_properties: each context independently detects authoritative tip replacement through /status
one context becoming current cannot implicitly update another context
status outage in one context cannot contaminate another context
remote tip change between nonce and submit is blocked locally by freshness barrier
same-device hints are optional acceleration only and never correctness authority
mts_09_authority.runtime_patch_gate: Only a deterministic MTS-09 reproduction exposing a correctness defect may authorize runtime writes.

mts_10_authority_preview.invariant: BroadcastChannel may only trigger faster authoritative /status revalidation. It may never declare the chain tip, cancel work by itself, or become required for correctness.
mts_10_authority_preview.failure_policy: Removing or disabling BroadcastChannel must preserve all MTS-09 correctness guarantees.

required_invariants: BroadcastChannel message is never chain authority
hint payload is not trusted as height or tip_hash
receiver must call authoritative /status before cancellation
hint-triggered /status failure must not cancel work
mts_10_authority.patch_gate: Authorize runtime change only if baseline proves measurable avoidable latency and the candidate can satisfy all invariants.

mts_10_patch_authorization.scope: mining.js + byte-identical Sovereign Forge mirror + exact hash renewal
required_behavior: same-device hint triggers immediate /status revalidation without waiting for the 2000ms poll
hint message never carries authoritative tip semantics
false hint with unchanged /status does not cancel work
hint-triggered /status outage does not cancel work
BroadcastChannel unavailable preserves independent polling correctness
stale discovered by authoritative observation may emit one acceleration hint without feedback storm

mts_11_authority_preview.scope: real-browser integration and stale-work cancellation latency gate
objectives: exercise actual browser scheduling semantics beyond the deterministic VM harness
measure hint-to-authoritative-cancel latency and poll-only fallback latency
prove multi-tab correctness with BroadcastChannel disabled and enabled
prepare physical-device iPad validation without changing consensus or block time

required_properties: same-origin real BroadcastChannel causes peer authoritative /status revalidation before the peer poll timer
hint-to-cancel latency is materially lower than poll-only fallback latency
forged hint payload cannot cancel current work when authoritative /status is unchanged
hint-triggered /status outage cannot cancel current work
BroadcastChannel disabled preserves poll-only convergence
peer restarts on a template whose previous_hash matches the new authoritative tip
zero stale submissions occur in validation scenarios
mts_11_authority.real_pow_policy: Use the production Worker implementation with an effectively unsatisfiable test difficulty so the test measures cancellation rather than nonce discovery.
mts_11_authority.runtime_patch_gate: No runtime write unless Chromium or WebKit exposes a deterministic correctness defect or the latency optimization fails its frozen gate.

mts_12_authority_preview.scope: physical-device iPad acceptance and long-running user-journey confirmation
objectives: confirm Start Mining once remains self-healing across real chain advances on physical iPad Safari
confirm two or more same-device tabs abandon stale work automatically after another tab or remote miner advances the chain
observe background/foreground recovery on iPadOS without manual Stop -> Start
record physical stale-work cancellation behavior without introducing telemetry, secrets, consensus changes, or block-time changes
mts_12_authority_preview.prerequisite: MTS-11 Chromium + WebKit real-browser gate GREEN
mts_12_authority_preview.rule: Physical-device evidence may validate deployment/browser integration; it cannot weaken authoritative /status semantics.

mts_12_authority.deployment_rule: Use a preview built from the exact MTS-11 GREEN main plus Lab-only acceptance files; production promotion is not required for evidence.
mts_12_authority.privacy_rule: All acceptance observations remain device-local unless the user explicitly exports the JSON artifact. No telemetry, seed phrase, private key, wallet backup, or reusable secret may be collected.
required_properties: the exact protected MTS-10/MTS-11 miner bytes are loaded on the physical device
Start Mining is invoked once per participating context and no manual Stop -> Start is used for tip changes
two same-origin Safari contexts can mine watch-only and converge after a real public-testnet tip advance
each replacement template binds the new authoritative previous_hash
background -> foreground return triggers automatic authoritative revalidation without manual restart
BroadcastChannel absence/degradation cannot break polling correctness
zero stale submissions are observed by the local acceptance recorder
no private wallet material is required or recorded

physical_latency_gate.note: Physical WAN/Safari gate is intentionally looser than MTS-11 local-browser CI while still bounding avoidable stale work.

mts_12_authority.completion_rule: MTS-12 cannot be GREEN without evidence produced on a physical iPad Safari session. Preparation/preview checks alone may only reach PREPARED_NOT_STARTED or READY_FOR_PHYSICAL_RUN.
